query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT SUM(headcount) FROM attendance_weekly WHERE year = 2026 AND campus = 'Canton' AND subgroup = 'Revolution Canton Check-In' AND weekStartDate BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-31' AND cancelled = 0) as weekly_main_checkin,
  (SELECT total FROM attendance_monthly WHERE year = 2026 AND month = 1 AND campus = 'Canton' AND subgroup = 'Revolution Canton Check-In') as monthly_main_checkin,
  (SELECT total FROM attendance_monthly WHERE year = 2026 AND month = 1 AND campus = 'Canton' AND subgroup = 'Adults') as monthly_adults;
